fullPassage:
During New York Fashion Week 2018, a woman with a brightly decorated prosthetic leg proudly walked the runway at a major fashion show. She was Mama Cax, a model and influencer.

Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and struggled to accept her new body. However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it. One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media showing her leg. "I didn't think it could help anyone," she said in an interview, "But after receiving messages of support, I realized my story could inspire others." After receiving support from others, she began to use social media to share more about her life and to inspire others. She proudly posted pictures of herself wearing stylish prosthetic covers and spoke out about body positivity and fashion. In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll campaign. In 2018, she appeared on the cover of major fashion magazines.

When asked, "How did you come to embrace yourself?" she replied, "The truth is, like many people, I'm still on my journey to self-love. There are many barriers ahead." In addition to modeling, Cax showed her ability to overcome physical barriers by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing. She even finished the New York City Marathon in a wheelchair.

Sadly, Mama Cax's journey was cut short in 2019. Although she is no longer with us, her journey will remain in our hearts, inspiring us to overcome limitations and find our own paths to success and happiness.

questions.passage: During New York Fashion Week 2018, a woman with a brightly ①<u>decorated</u> prosthetic leg proudly walked the runway at a major fashion show. Cax was ②<u>diagnosing</u> with cancer at age 14 and ③<u>lost</u> her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and ④<u>struggled</u> to accept her new body.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: Cax는 14세에 암 진단을 받았다(was diagnosed).
det.analysis:
✅ ② diagnosing → diagnosed: 'was diagnosed with cancer'에서 Cax는 진단을 '받는' 쪽이므로 수동태(과거분사)가 맞음
❌ ① decorated: 과거분사의 전치수식. 화려하게 장식된 의족 다리. 정상
❌ ③ lost: 과거형 동사. and로 연결된 병렬 구조 정상
❌ ④ struggled: 과거형 동사. 'was depressed and struggled' 병렬 정상
det.tip: diagnose(진단하다): 의사가 진단 → 환자는 수동 'be diagnosed with ~'. -ing(능동) vs -ed(수동) 구별이 핵심

questions.passage: However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it. One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media ①<u>showing</u> her leg. After receiving messages of support, she began to use social media to share more about her life. She proudly posted pictures of herself ②<u>wearing</u> stylish prosthetic covers. In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll campaign. In 2018, she ③<u>was appeared</u> on the cover of major fashion ④<u>magazines</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 2018년에 그녀는 주요 패션 잡지의 표지에 등장했다(appeared).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ was appeared → appeared: appear는 자동사이므로 수동태 불가. 능동태 appeared가 맞음
❌ ① showing: 현재분사 후치수식. 'a picture showing her leg' 정상
❌ ② wearing: 현재분사. 'pictures of herself wearing' 목적격 보어 정상
❌ ④ magazines: 명사 복수형. 'fashion magazines' 정상
det.tip: 자동사(appear, happen, occur 등)는 수동태 불가. 'She appeared'(능동)이 올바름. 'was appeared'는 이중 수동 오류

questions.passage: When asked, "How did you come to embrace yourself?" she replied, "The truth is, like many people, I'm still on my journey to self-love." In addition to modeling, Cax showed her ability to overcome physical barriers by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing. Sadly, Mama Cax's journey was cut short in 2019. Although she is no longer with us, her journey will remain in our hearts, ①<u>inspiring</u> us ②<u>to overcome</u> limitations and ③<u>finding</u> our own paths to success and ④<u>happiness</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 한계를 극복하고 성공과 행복을 향한 길을 찾도록(find) 영감을 준다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ finding → find: 'inspiring us to overcome ~ and find ~'에서 to에 이어지는 병렬 원형이 필요. to overcome과 (to) find가 병렬이므로 finding은 부적절
❌ ① inspiring: 분사구문. 주어(her journey)가 능동이므로 현재분사 정상
❌ ② to overcome: to부정사. 'inspiring us to overcome' 정상
❌ ④ happiness: 명사. 'success and happiness' 병렬 정상
det.tip: to A and B: to 뒤 병렬 구조에서 B도 원형. to overcome and find(원형) vs to overcome and finding(동명사) → 병렬 오류

questions.passage: During New York Fashion Week 2018, a woman with a brightly ①<u>decorated</u> prosthetic leg proudly walked the runway at a major fashion show. Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was ②<u>delighted</u> and struggled to accept her new body. However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it. She proudly posted pictures of herself wearing stylish prosthetic covers and spoke out about body ③<u>positivity</u> and ④<u>fashion</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 처음에 Cax는 우울했고(depressed) 새 몸을 받아들이기 힘들어했다. delighted(기뻐하는)는 원문의 depressed(우울한)와 반대이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② delighted → depressed(우울한): 원문은 'Cax was depressed'. 다리를 잃은 직후 기뻐한다는 것은 'struggled to accept'과 모순
❌ ① decorated(장식된): 원문 그대로. 화려하게 장식된 의족
❌ ③ positivity(긍정성): 원문 그대로. body positivity
❌ ④ fashion(패션): 원문 그대로
det.tip: depressed(우울한) ↔ delighted(기뻐하는). struggled(힘들어했다)와 연결되는 감정은 부정적이어야 함

questions.passage: After receiving support from others, she began to use social media to share more about her life and to inspire others. When asked, "How did you come to embrace yourself?" she replied, "The truth is, like many people, I'm still on my journey to self-love. There are many ①<u>barriers</u> ahead." In addition to modeling, Cax showed her ability to ②<u>avoid</u> physical barriers by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing. She even ③<u>finished</u> the New York City Marathon in a ④<u>wheelchair</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: Cax는 수영, 농구, 산악 등반으로 신체적 장벽을 극복하는(overcome) 능력을 보여주었다. avoid(피하다)는 원문의 overcome(극복하다)와 반대이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② avoid → overcome(극복하다): 원문은 'ability to overcome physical barriers'. 수영, 농구, 등반으로 적극 도전한 것이므로 avoid(피하다)는 맥락과 모순
❌ ① barriers(장벽): 원문 그대로. 앞에 있는 많은 장벽
❌ ③ finished(완주했다): 원문 그대로. 마라톤 완주
❌ ④ wheelchair(휠체어): 원문 그대로. 휠체어로 마라톤
det.tip: overcome(극복하다) ↔ avoid(피하다). 적극적으로 도전(swimming, basketball, climbing)한 맥락이 overcome의 단서

questions.passage: Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and struggled to accept her new body. However, with the __________ of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it. One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media showing her leg. After receiving messages of encouragement, she began to share more about her life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가족과 친구들의 지지(support)로 Cax는 자신의 몸을 사랑하는 법을 배웠다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① support(지지): 'learned to love it'이라는 긍정적 결과의 원인. However로 전환된 맥락
❌ ② disapproval(불찬성): 부정적 반응이면 사랑을 배우기 어려움
❌ ③ competition(경쟁): 가족 간 경쟁은 맥락과 무관
❌ ④ isolation(고립): 가족과 친구의 고립이면 도움이 되지 않음
det.tip: However가 전환의 신호. depressed(부정) → However → support(긍정 요인) → love(긍정 결과)

questions.passage: "I didn't think it could help anyone," she said in an interview, "But after receiving messages of support, I realized my story could inspire others." After receiving support from others, she began to use social media to share more about her life and to inspire others. She proudly posted pictures of herself wearing stylish prosthetic covers and spoke out about body __________. In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll campaign.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그녀는 세련된 의족 커버를 착용한 사진을 자랑스럽게 올리고 신체 긍정주의(positivity)에 대해 목소리를 높였다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ positivity(긍정주의): 원문 일치. body positivity는 있는 그대로의 몸을 긍정하는 사회운동
❌ ① negativity(부정성): 'proudly', 'stylish', 'inspire'라는 긍정적 맥락과 모순
❌ ② perfection(완벽): body positivity는 완벽이 아닌 수용을 강조
❌ ③ anonymity(익명성): 사진을 자랑스럽게 올린 것은 익명과 반대
det.tip: body positivity = 신체 긍정주의: 모든 체형과 외모를 있는 그대로 긍정하는 운동. proudly, stylish가 단서

questions.passage: During New York Fashion Week 2018, a woman with a brightly decorated prosthetic leg proudly walked the runway at a major fashion show. She was Mama Cax, a model and influencer. Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and struggled to accept her new body.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: Mama Cax는 2016년 뉴욕 패션 위크에서 런웨이를 걸었다.
Cax는 수술 후 오른쪽 다리를 잃었다.
Cax는 처음부터 자신의 새로운 몸을 쉽게 받아들였다.

det.korean: "Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery." 수술 후 오른쪽 다리를 잃었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 수술 후 오른쪽 다리 상실: 원문 그대로
❌ ① 2018년이지 2016년이 아님
❌ ② 16세에 다리를 잃었고, 14세에 암 진단을 받음 (나이 혼동)
❌ ④ 'struggled to accept'이므로 쉽게 받아들인 것이 아님
det.tip: 14세 = 암 진단(diagnosed), 16세 = 다리 상실(lost). 2018년 = 패션 위크

questions.passage: She proudly posted pictures of herself wearing stylish prosthetic covers and spoke out about body positivity and fashion. In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll campaign. In 2018, she appeared on the cover of major fashion magazines.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: Cax는 수수한 의족 커버를 착용한 사진을 올렸다.
Cax는 2016년에 #RunwayForAll 캠페인의 첫 번째 모델이 되었다.
Cax는 신체 부정주의에 대해 목소리를 높였다.

det.korean: "In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll campaign." 원문과 일치한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 2016년 #RunwayForAll 첫 모델: 원문 그대로
❌ ① 'stylish'(세련된)이지 수수한이 아님
❌ ③ 패션 잡지 표지는 2018년. 2016년이 아님
❌ ④ body positivity(긍정주의)이지 부정주의가 아님
det.tip: 2016년 = #RunwayForAll, 2018년 = 잡지 표지. stylish = 세련된 ≠ 수수한

questions.passage: When asked, "How did you come to embrace yourself?" she replied, "The truth is, like many people, I'm still on my journey to self-love. There are many barriers ahead." In addition to modeling, Cax showed her ability to overcome physical barriers by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing. She even finished the New York City Marathon in a wheelchair.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: Cax는 자기 사랑의 여정이 완성되었다고 말했다.
Cax는 수영, 농구, 산악 등반으로 장벽을 극복했다.
Cax는 모델 활동 외에도 다양한 신체 활동을 했다.

det.korean: Cax는 "I'm still on my journey"라고 했으므로 여정이 완성되었다는 것은 거짓이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① '완성되었다'는 불일치: still on my journey(여전히 여정 중) = 아직 완성되지 않음
❌ ② 원문 일치: swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing
❌ ③ 원문 일치: finished the NYC Marathon in a wheelchair
❌ ④ 원문 일치: 'In addition to modeling'(모델 활동 외에도)
det.tip: 'still'(여전히)은 진행 중임을 나타냄. '완성'과 '진행 중'은 모순

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 소셜 미디어의 부정적 영향과 해결 방안
뉴욕 패션 위크의 다양성과 포용 정책
암 치료 기술의 발전과 환자 지원 체계
역경을 극복하고 타인에게 영감을 준 Mama Cax의 여정

det.korean: 이 글의 주제는 역경을 극복하고 타인에게 영감을 준 Mama Cax의 여정이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ Cax의 극복과 영감의 여정: 암→우울→지지→사랑→영감의 흐름이 핵심
❌ ① 소셜 미디어 부정적 영향이 아닌 긍정적 활용
❌ ② 패션 위크는 배경일 뿐 주제가 아님
❌ ③ 암 치료 기술이 아닌 심리적 극복이 핵심
det.tip: 반복 키워드: inspire(3회), overcome(2회), journey(3회), self-love가 주제를 가리킴

questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: The Dark Side of Social Media
How to Become a Fashion Model

det.korean: 이 글의 제목은 A Journey to Self-Love(자기 사랑으로의 여정)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ A Journey to Self-Love: 원문 제목이자 글 전체의 핵심 메시지. 자기 수용과 사랑의 여정
❌ ① 소셜 미디어의 어두운 면이 아닌 긍정적 활용
❌ ② 패션 모델이 되는 방법이 아닌 자기 사랑의 이야기
❌ ④ 의족 기술 역사가 아닌 인간적 이야기
det.tip: 제목은 글의 핵심 메시지를 함축. journey(여정) + self-love(자기 사랑)이 가장 포괄적

questions.passage: One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media showing her leg. <u>"I didn't think it could help anyone,"</u> she said in an interview, "But after receiving messages of support, I realized my story could inspire others." When asked, "How did you come to embrace yourself?" she replied, "The truth is, like many people, I'm still on my journey to self-love. There are many barriers ahead."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 "I didn't think it could help anyone"이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 자신의 다리 사진이 유명해질 것을 예상했다.
자신의 경험을 공유하는 것이 타인에게 도움이 될 거라 기대하지 않았다.

det.korean: "나는 그것이 누구에게든 도움이 될 수 있다고 생각하지 않았다" — 자신의 경험 공유가 타인에게 영감을 줄 거라 예상하지 못했다는 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 타인에게 도움이 될 거라 기대하지 않음: 'didn't think it could help anyone'을 직접 해석한 것. But 이후 메시지를 받고 깨달았다는 전환과 연결
❌ ① '유명해질 것을 예상'은 원문에 없는 내용
❌ ③ 소셜 미디어의 위험성은 언급되지 않음
❌ ④ 후회가 아니라 기대의 부재. But 이후 긍정적으로 전환
det.tip: didn't think ~ could: ~할 수 있을 거라 생각하지 않았다. 겸손함/예상 못함. But이 전환 신호

questions.passage: During New York Fashion Week 2018, a woman with a brightly decorated prosthetic leg proudly walked the runway at a major fashion show. She was Mama Cax, a model and influencer. Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and struggled to accept her new body. However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love <u>it</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>it</u>이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Cax는 자신의 새로운 몸(her new body)을 사랑하는 법을 배웠다. it은 앞 문장의 'her new body'를 가리킨다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ her new body: 'struggled to accept her new body' → 'learned to love it'에서 it은 직전 문장의 her new body를 받음
❌ ① cancer diagnosis: 암 진단을 사랑한다는 것은 부자연스러움
❌ ② prosthetic leg: 의족이 아니라 새로운 몸 전체
❌ ③ social media: 이 시점에서 아직 소셜 미디어 언급 없음
det.tip: 대명사 it의 지칭 대상은 보통 직전 문장에서 찾는다. accept her new body → love it의 대응 관계

questions.passage: She proudly posted pictures of herself wearing stylish prosthetic covers and spoke out about body positivity and fashion. In addition to modeling, Cax showed her ability to overcome physical barriers by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing. She even finished the New York City Marathon in a wheelchair. Sadly, Mama Cax's journey was cut short in 2019. Although <u>she</u> is no longer with us, her journey will remain in our hearts, inspiring us to overcome limitations and find our own paths to success and happiness.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>she</u>가 가리키는 인물로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Mama Cax는 더 이상 우리와 함께하지 않지만, 그녀의 여정은 우리 마음속에 남을 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① Mama Cax: 직전 문장 'Mama Cax's journey was cut short'에서 Mama Cax를 받는 대명사
❌ ② Cax's mother: 이 문단에서 어머니 언급 없음
❌ ③ a fashion designer: 패션 디자이너 언급 없음
❌ ④ a cancer researcher: 암 연구자 언급 없음
det.tip: 대명사 she는 직전에 언급된 여성 인물을 가리킴. 'Mama Cax's journey' 바로 다음 문장이므로 Mama Cax가 명확

questions.passage: In addition to modeling, Cax showed her ability to overcome physical barriers by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing. She even finished the New York City Marathon in a wheelchair.
questions.stem:
본문에 따르면, Cax가 뉴욕시 마라톤을 완주한 방법을 **영어**로 쓰시오.

Cax가 마라톤에서 사용한 것: a __________

det.korean: Cax는 휠체어(wheelchair)로 뉴욕시 마라톤을 완주했다.
det.analysis: 원문: 'She even finished the New York City Marathon in a wheelchair.' wheelchair가 정답
det.tip: wheelchair = 휠체어. in a wheelchair = 휠체어를 타고. even은 놀라운 사실을 강조

questions.passage: "I didn't think it could help anyone," she said in an interview, "But after receiving messages of support, I realized my story could inspire others." She proudly posted pictures of herself wearing stylish prosthetic covers and spoke out about body positivity and fashion. In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll campaign.
questions.stem:
본문에 따르면, Cax가 2016년에 최초로 참여한 것을 **영어**로 쓰시오.

Cax became the first model for the #RunwayForAll __________.

det.korean: Cax는 2016년에 #RunwayForAll 캠페인(campaign)의 첫 번째 모델이 되었다.
det.analysis: 원문: 'In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll campaign.' campaign이 정답
det.tip: campaign = 캠페인/운동. #RunwayForAll은 다양성과 포용을 위한 패션 캠페인

questions.passage: Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and struggled to accept her new body. __________. One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media showing her leg.
questions.stem: 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. learned / her family and friends / to love it / with the support of / Cax / however
questions.wa: However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it
accept: However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it
However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it.
however, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it
However with the support of her family and friends Cax learned to love it

det.korean: 하지만, 가족과 친구들의 지지로, Cax는 그것을 사랑하는 법을 배웠다.
det.analysis: However(하지만) + with the support of her family and friends(가족과 친구들의 지지로) + Cax learned(Cax는 배웠다) + to love it(그것을 사랑하는 것을). However가 전환 접속부사로 문장 맨 앞에 위치
det.tip: However + 쉼표: 전환 접속부사. with the support of: ~의 지지로. learn to + 동사원형: ~하는 법을 배우다

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 영작하시오.

"비록 그녀가 더 이상 우리와 함께하지 않지만, 그녀의 여정은 우리 마음속에 남을 것이다."

(although / no longer / remain / in our hearts)
questions.wa: Although she is no longer with us, her journey will remain in our hearts
accept: Although she is no longer with us, her journey will remain in our hearts
Although she is no longer with us, her journey will remain in our hearts.
although she is no longer with us, her journey will remain in our hearts
Although she is no longer with us her journey will remain in our hearts

det.korean: 비록(Although) 그녀가 더 이상(no longer) 우리와 함께하지 않지만, 그녀의 여정은 우리 마음속에 남을(remain in our hearts) 것이다.
det.analysis: Although(비록 ~이지만) + she is no longer with us(더 이상 함께하지 않는다) + her journey will remain(여정은 남을 것이다) + in our hearts(우리 마음속에)
det.tip: Although = 비록 ~이지만 (양보 접속사). no longer = 더 이상 ~않는. remain = 남다/계속 존재하다

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 영작하시오.

"지지 메시지를 받은 후, 나는 내 이야기가 다른 사람들에게 영감을 줄 수 있다고 깨달았다."

(after / receiving / messages of support / realized / inspire)
questions.wa: After receiving messages of support, I realized my story could inspire others
accept: After receiving messages of support, I realized my story could inspire others
After receiving messages of support, I realized my story could inspire others.
after receiving messages of support, I realized my story could inspire others
After receiving messages of support I realized my story could inspire others

det.korean: 지지 메시지를 받은 후(After receiving messages of support), 나는 내 이야기가 다른 사람들에게 영감을 줄(inspire) 수 있다고 깨달았다(realized).
det.analysis: After receiving(~을 받은 후) + messages of support(지지 메시지) + I realized(나는 깨달았다) + my story could inspire others(내 이야기가 다른 사람들에게 영감을 줄 수 있다). After + -ing = ~한 후에 (분사구문)
det.tip: After + -ing: ~한 후에. could + 동사원형: ~할 수 있다. realize (that) + 절: ~을 깨닫다
